This section groups the observational-study chapters:

- [Chapter 11: The Central Role of the Propensity Score](ch11-propensity-score.html)
- [Chapter 12: Doubly Robust ATE Estimation](ch12-double-robust-ate.html)
- [Chapter 13: ATT and Other Estimands](ch13-double-robust-att.html)
- [Chapter 27: Mediation Analysis](ch27-mediation.html)

These chapters use the following estimators for nuisance fits, weighting, and treatment-effect estimation:

- `Logit`
- `BalancingWeights`
- `AIPW`
- plain `OLS` or `Ridge` nuisance fits when needed

## What Is Covered

- overlap diagnostics and subclassification
- entropy and quadratic balancing weights
- manual and cross-fit AIPW logic
- ATT versus ATE targeting
- Baron-Kenny mediation as a transparent pair of `OLS` regressions
